# st-unitycatalog_tables (Data Source)

Lists tables in a Unity Catalog catalog, optionally filtered by schema, via
`GET /api/2.1/unity-catalog/tables?catalog_name=...&schema_name=...`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all tables in a catalog
data "st-unitycatalog_tables" "all" {
  catalog_name = "my-catalog"
}

# List tables filtered by schema
data "st-unitycatalog_tables" "by_schema" {
  catalog_name = "my-catalog"
  schema_name  = "my-catalog-schema"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) The catalog name to list tables from. Required.

### Optional

- `schema_name` (String) The schema name to filter tables by. When omitted, all tables in the catalog are returned.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The data source identifier: catalog_name[.schema_name].
- `tables` (Attributes List) The list of tables in the catalog (or schema). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tables))

<a id="nestedatt--tables"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tables`

Read-Only:

- `catalog_name` (String) The catalog name.
- `schema_name` (String) The schema name.
- `name` (String) The table name.
- `table_type` (String) The table type (e.g. MANAGED, EXTERNAL, VIEW).
- `comment` (String) An optional comment on the table.
